ITLibAlbum.doc: This class provides information about an album in the iTunes library.

ITLibArtist.doc: This class represents an artist, such as the performer of a song.

ITLibArtwork.doc: This class represents the artwork for a media item.

ITLibMediaEntity.doc: This class describes a media entity, which can be a media item, such as an audio track.

ITLibMediaItem.doc: This class describes a media item (a track) in the iTunes library, such as a song, a video, or a podcast.

ITLibMediaItemVideoInfo.doc: This class encapsulates the video information of a video media item.

ITLibPlaylist.doc: This class describes a playlist in the iTunes library.

ITLibrary.doc: This class serves as the entry point to the iTunesLibrary framework.

ITLibArtworkFormat.doc: These constants specify the possible formats of the data that imageDataFormat returns.

ITLibArtworkFormatBMP.doc: The image data corresponds to a bitmap image.

ITLibArtworkFormatBitmap.doc: The image data corresponds to a bitmap image.

ITLibArtworkFormatGIF.doc: The image data corresponds to a GIF image.

ITLibArtworkFormatJPEG.doc: The image data corresponds to a JPEG image.

ITLibArtworkFormatJPEG2000.doc: The image data corresponds to a JPEG2000 image.

ITLibArtworkFormatNone.doc: The image data format is unknown.

ITLibArtworkFormatPICT.doc: The image data corresponds to a PICT image.

ITLibArtworkFormatPNG.doc: The image data corresponds to a PNG image.

ITLibArtworkFormatTIFF.doc: The image data corresponds to a TIFF image.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKind.doc: These constants specify the possible kinds of distinguished playlists.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKind90sMusic.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s music from the 1990s.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindApplicatio.doc: The playlist contains all the user’s iOS apps in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindAudiobooks.doc: The playlist contains all the audiobooks in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindBooks.doc: The playlist contains all the audiobooks in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindClassicalM.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s classical music.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindHomeVideos.doc: The playlist contains all the user’s home videos in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindLibraryMus.doc: The playlist contains all the music videos in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindLovedSongs.doc: The playlist contains all the user’s loved music.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindMovies.doc: The playlist contains all the movies in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindMusic.doc: The playlist contains all the music items in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindMusicShows.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s music shows and movies.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindMusicVideo.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s music videos.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindMyTopRated.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s top rated media items.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindNone.doc: The playlist isn’t a distinguished playlist.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindPodcasts.doc: The playlist contains all the podcasts in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindPurchases.doc: The playlist contains all the user’s purchases from the iTunes Store.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindRecentlyAd.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s most recently added media items.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindRecentlyPl.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s most recently played media items.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindRingtones.doc: The playlist contains all the iOS ringtones in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindTVShows.doc: The playlist contains all the TV shows in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindTop25MostP.doc: The default Smart Playlist that iTunes creates of the user’s 25 most played media items.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindVoiceMemos.doc: The playlist contains all the voice memos in the iTunes library.

ITLibDistinguishedPlaylistKindiTunesU.doc: The playlist contains all the user’s iTunes U items.

ITLibExportFeature.doc: These constants describe the features that an iTunes library supports.

ITLibExportFeatureNone.doc: The iTunes library doesn’t support any export features.

ITLibInitOptions.doc: These constants describe initialization options for an iTunes library.

ITLibInitOptionLazyLoadData.doc: iTunes library data loads upon request, rather than during initialization.

ITLibMediaItemLocationType.doc: These constants specify the location type of a media item.

ITLibMediaItemLocationTypeFile.doc: The media item location refers to a local file.

ITLibMediaItemLocationTypeRemote.doc: The media item location refers to a remote file.

ITLibMediaItemLocationTypeURL.doc: The media item location refers to a URL, such as a podcast.

ITLibMediaItemLocationTypeUnknown.doc: The media item location type is unknown.

ITLibMediaItemLyricsContentRating.doc: These constants specify the possible ratings of media item lyrics.

ITLibMediaItemLyricsContentRatingClean.doc: The media item lyrics don’t contain explicit language.

ITLibMediaItemLyricsContentRatingExplici.doc: The media item lyrics contain explicit language.

ITLibMediaItemLyricsContentRatingNone.doc: There is no rating information for the media item lyrics.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKind.doc: These constants specify the possible media kinds of a media item.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindAlertTone.doc: The media item is an audio tone that’s not a protected ringtone on an iOS device.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindAudiobook.doc: The media item is an audiobook.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindBook.doc: The media item is an EPUB file or an iBooks Author book.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindDigitalBooklet.doc: The media item is an iTunes Extra or an iTunes LP item.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindHomeVideo.doc: The media item is a non-iTunes Store movie.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindIOSApplication.doc: The media item is an iOS app.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindInteractiveBookle.doc: The media item is a QuickTime movie with embedded Flash.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindMovie.doc: The media item is a movie.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindMusicVideo.doc: The media item is a music video.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindPDFBook.doc: The media item is a PDF file that iTunes treats as a book unless the user overrides it.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindPDFBooklet.doc: The media item is an unwrapped PDF file that’s part of a music album.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindPodcast.doc: The media item is an audio or a video podcast.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindRingtone.doc: The media item is an iOS ringtone.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindSong.doc: The media item is a song.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindTVShow.doc: The media item is a TV show.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindUnknown.doc: The media item kind is unknown.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindVoiceMemo.doc: The media item is a recorded voice memo.

ITLibMediaItemMediaKindiTunesU.doc: The media item is an iTunes U audio or video file.

ITLibMediaItemPlayStatus.doc: These constants specify the play status of the media item.

ITLibMediaItemPlayStatusNone.doc: The user has played the media item or iTunes doesn’t track the play status for this kind of media item.

ITLibMediaItemPlayStatusPartiallyPlayed.doc: The user has partially played the media item.

ITLibMediaItemPlayStatusUnplayed.doc: The user hasn’t played the media item.

ITLibPlaylistKind.doc: These constants specify the possible kinds of playlists.

ITLibPlaylistKindFolder.doc: A playlist folder that the user or iTunes creates, such as My Playlist Folder or Genius Mixes.

ITLibPlaylistKindGenius.doc: A playlist iTunes creates of songs that go well with a song the user specifies.

ITLibPlaylistKindGeniusMix.doc: An ongoing playlist in a particular genre—like a commercial-free radio station playing the user’s favorite songs—that iTunes creates from music in the user’s iTunes library.

ITLibPlaylistKindRegular.doc: A standard playlist that the user or iTunes creates, such as Music, Movies, Pop Mix, or My Awesome Playlist.

ITLibPlaylistKindSmart.doc: A playlist with contents that iTunes generates by evaluating a set of rules, such as 90s Music or Songs from 1999.

-enumerateValuesExceptForProperties:usin.doc: Executes a provided block with the fetched values for all properties in the entity except for the provided set.

-enumerateValuesForProperties:usingBlock.doc: Executes a provided block with the fetched values for the item properties.

-valueForProperty:.doc: Gets the value for a specified media property key.

+libraryWithAPIVersion:error:.doc: Creates and initializes an instance of ITLibrary that can retrieve media entities.

+libraryWithAPIVersion:options:error:.doc: Creates and initializes an instance of ITLibrary that can retrieve media entities.

-artworkForMediaFile:.doc: Retrieves the artwork from a media file that may or may not be in the iTunes library.

-initWithAPIVersion:error:.doc: Initializes an instance of ITLibrary that can retrieve media entities.

-initWithAPIVersion:options:error:.doc: Initializes an instance of ITLibrary that can retrieve media entities.

-reloadData.doc: Refreshes the data that the framework uses.

-unloadData.doc: Unloads the data that the framework uses.

albumArtist.doc: The name of the artist iTunes associates with the album.

artist.doc: The artist iTunes associates with the album.

compilation.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the album is a compilation.

discCount.doc: The number of discs in a multiple-disc set.

discNumber.doc: The index (1, 2, 3, and so on) of the disc within an album that’s a multiple-disc set.

gapless.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the album is gapless.

persistentID.doc: The unique identifier of the album.

ratingComputed.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the system computes the rating of the album using the ratings of individual tracks in the album.

sortAlbumArtist.doc: The name to use when sorting by album artist.

sortTitle.doc: The title to use when sorting by album title.

trackCount.doc: The number of tracks in the album.

persistentID.doc: The unique identifier of the artist.

sortName.doc: The name of the artist to use when sorting.

imageData.doc: The raw image data of the artwork in the format that imageDataFormat specifies.

imageDataFormat.doc: The format of the artwork image data that imageData returns.

persistentID.doc: The unique identifier of the media entity.

addedDate.doc: The date and time that the user added the media item to the iTunes library.

album.doc: The album of the media item.

artist.doc: Information about the artist that iTunes associates with the media item.

artwork.doc: The artwork of the media item.

artworkAvailable.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the media item has artwork.

beatsPerMinute.doc: The beats-per-minute (BPM) of the media item.

bitrate.doc: The bitrate of the media item in kbit/s.

category.doc: The podcast category of the media item, if the media item is a podcast.

cloud.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether this media item is an iTunes Match or an iTunes in the Cloud item.

comments.doc: Any comments that iTunes associates with the media item.

composer.doc: The name of the composer that iTunes associates with the media item.

contentRating.doc: The content rating of the media item.

description.doc: The description of the media item, if it’s a podcast.

drmProtected.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the media item has digital rights management (DRM) protection.

fileSize.doc: The size in bytes of this media item on disk.

fileType.doc: The file type of the media item.

genre.doc: The genre of the media item, if any.

grouping.doc: The grouping of the media item that the user specifies or that iTunes specifies in the file’s metadata.

kind.doc: The kind of media item file, such as an MPEG audio file.

lastPlayedDate.doc: The date and time the user last played the media item, or nil if the user hasn’t played it.

location.doc: The location of the media item on disk.

locationType.doc: The type of the media item with respect to its location.

lyricsContentRating.doc: The content rating of the media item’s lyrics.

modifiedDate.doc: The date and time that iTunes last modified the media item.

playCount.doc: The number of times the user has played the media item.

playStatus.doc: The play status for the media.

purchased.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the user purchased the media item from the iTunes Store.

rating.doc: The rating of the media item.

ratingComputed.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether iTunes computes the media item’s rating from its album rating.

releaseDate.doc: The release date of the media item.

sampleRate.doc: The sample rate of the media item in samples-per-second.

size.doc: The size in bytes of the media item on disk.

skipCount.doc: The number of times that the user skipped the media item.

skipDate.doc: The date and time that the user last skipped the media item.

sortComposer.doc: The name to use when sorting by composer.

sortTitle.doc: The title of the media item to use when sorting.

startTime.doc: If nonzero, the actual time playback of the media item starts instead of 0:00 (in milliseconds).

stopTime.doc: If nonzero, the actual time playback of the media item stops versus the total time (in milliseconds).

title.doc: The title of the media item.

totalTime.doc: The length of the media item in milliseconds.

trackNumber.doc: The position of the media item within its album.

userDisabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the user disabled the media item.

video.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether this media item is a video, such as a TV show, video podcast, or movie.

videoInfo.doc: Video information (such as width and height) about the media item, if it’s a video.

voiceOverLanguage.doc: The voice-over language of the media item.

volumeAdjustment.doc: The volume adjustment for the media item, if any.

volumeNormalizationEnergy.doc: The volume normalization energy that iTunes applies to the media item to bring the average or peak amplitude to a target level.

year.doc: The release year of the media item.

episode.doc: The name of the episode, if the media item is an episode of a TV series.

episodeOrder.doc: The numerical order of the episode, if the media item is an episode of a TV series.

hd.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the video is high-definition.

season.doc: The corresponding TV season, if the media item is an episode of a TV series.

series.doc: The name of the corresponding TV series, if the media item is an episode in a TV series.

sortSeries.doc: The sorting name of the corresponding TV series, if the media item is an episode in a TV series.

videoHeight.doc: The height of the video in pixels.

videoWidth.doc: The width of the video in pixels.

allItemsPlaylist.doc: Indicates whether the API exposes every item in the playlist.

distinguishedKind.doc: An indication of whether the playlist has a special distinction.

items.doc: The media items (tracks) in the playlist.

kind.doc: An indication of the type of playlist.

master.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the playlist represents the entire iTunes library.

name.doc: The name or title of the playlist.

parentID.doc: The unique persistent identifier of the playlist’s parent playlist.

primary.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the playlist is the primary playlist.

visible.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the playlist is visible to the user in iTunes.

allMediaItems.doc: All the media items (tracks) in the iTunes library.

allPlaylists.doc: All the playlists in the iTunes library.

apiMajorVersion.doc: The major version number of the API the iTunesLibrary framework exposes.

apiMinorVersion.doc: The minor version number of the API the iTunesLibrary framework exposes.

applicationVersion.doc: The version of iTunes that created or modified the iTunes library you’re accessing.

features.doc: A bitwise OR combination of the features of this library.

mediaFolderLocation.doc: The location of the iTunes music folder.

musicFolderLocation.doc: The location of the iTunes music folder.

showContentRating.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether to show content rating labels.
